name: g2-vision-ai
description: Action Button photo → Render → OpenAI vision → Even G2 HUD

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,g2 -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w even-app"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w even-app
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w even-app
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w even-app
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w even-app
